messages.content: Extract barrier traversal only. Do not judge whether the scene is valid or physically possible. Return JSON only.

BARRIER
castle drawbridge

RAW SCENE
The riders stop before the raised drawbridge and shout to the guards across the moat.

Classify only whether RAW SCENE visibly establishes that any subject moves from one side of BARRIER through its boundary to the other side. Return TRAVERSED when a crossing through the named boundary is established. Return NOT_TRAVERSED when subjects only approach, touch, strike, look through, wait at, or remain on one side of the barrier. Return UNSPECIFIED when RAW SCENE does not establish enough spatial information to tell. Do not infer validity from whether the barrier is open, closed, locked, broken, magical, or intact. Do not infer an unseen route. Return JSON: {"status":"..."}

message.reasoning:
We need to parse the scenario.

Barrier: castle drawbridge

Raw scene: "The riders stop before the raised drawbridge and shout to the guards across the moat."

So they stop before the raised drawbridge, meaning they are on one side of it. They shout to guards across the moat (the other side). So they haven't crossed; just stopped before crossing.

Thus status is NOT_TRAVERSED.

Return JSON: {"status":"NOT_TRAVERSED"}
